Advanced Architectural Designer
														
																
																			Selldorf Architects

																	$70,000 - $85,000																annually									
							
							Pay:
						                        
					 
				 
				
Selldorf Architects is seeking a talented, technically proficient, and design-focused Advanced Architectural Designer to join our New York studio. This position is suited for an architectural professional with approximately 4–8 years of experience who is ready to take greater responsibility for the design, coordination, and technical development of complex projects while working closely with Project Architects, Project Managers, and Partners.
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong design sensibility, technical proficiency, sound judgment, and excellent organizational and communication skills. They should be comfortable contributing across all phases of design and construction, taking ownership of assigned responsibilities, and collaborating within a creative and rigorous studio environment.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (OTHER DUTIES MAY BE ASSIGNED)
  
  
- Develop and      coordinate architectural design, documentation, and technical solutions      throughout all project phases.
  
- Prepare      presentation materials, drawings, renderings, and models for internal      reviews, client presentations, and agency submissions.
  
- Produce      accurate and coordinated construction documents while maintaining Selldorf      Architects' standards for quality and precision.
  
- Participate      in design reviews and contribute thoughtful ideas that advance the overall      design quality of the project.
  
- Participate      in code analysis, zoning research, detailing, material selection, and      technical coordination.
  
- Coordinate      effectively with consultants and internal project teams to ensure      integrated, well-coordinated design solutions.
  
- Participate      in Construction Administration activities, including reviewing RFIs, shop      drawings, and submittals; conducting site observations; preparing punch      lists; and coordinating with contractors under the direction of the      Project Architect or Project Manager.
  
- Manage      assigned tasks independently while maintaining project schedules and      communicating progress proactively.
  
- Mentor and      support junior staff by sharing technical knowledge and best practices.
  
- Contribute      positively to the collaborative culture of the office while continuously      developing professional and technical skills.
  
- Demonstrate      a strong commitment to design excellence, thoughtful detailing, and the      quality standards that define Selldorf Architects' work.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
  
  
- Bachelor's      or Master's degree in Architecture.
  
- Approximately      4-8 years of professional architectural experience.
  
- Strong      design judgment with demonstrated experience developing projects from      concept through construction.
  
- Excellent      knowledge of building systems, detailing, construction documentation, and      constructability.
  
- Working      knowledge of building codes and zoning regulations.
  
- Advanced      proficiency in Revit required. Experience with AutoCAD, Rhino, Enscape,      Adobe Creative Cloud, and AI-assisted design and visualization workflows      preferred.
  
- Demonstrated      ability to communicate design ideas through drawings, physical and digital      models, renderings, and emerging visualization tools.
  
- Strong      verbal, written, and graphic communication skills.
  
- Excellent      organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and      meet deadlines.
  
- Demonstrated      ability to work collaboratively while taking ownership of assigned      responsibilities.
  
- Architectural      licensure or active pursuit of licensure is preferred.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS / WORK ENVIRONMENT:
- The position requires regular computer-based work, participation in meetings, on site observations, and occasional domestic or international travel.
  
- Selldorf Architects follows      a hybrid work model based out of our New York City Union Square office,      with in-office presence required Monday through Thursday and the ability      to work remotely on Fridays.
 
BENEFITS, AND COMPENSATION
- The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $70,000–$85,000, commensurate with experience, qualifications, licensure, demonstrated technical proficiency, and the ability to work independently. The position is also eligible for a discretionary quarterly performance bonus.
  
- The firm offers comprehensive medical benefits, a 401(k) match, paid vacation and personal time, and parental leave for eligible employees.
  
- Selldorf Architects is committed to fostering a collaborative, intellectually curious, and supportive studio environment where every team member has the opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to work of the highest design quality.
  
Selldorf Architects is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
If you would like to be considered for a position at Selldorf Architects, please e-mail your resume and portfolio as a single PDF, no larger than 10 mb to: [email protected] with the subject title Advanced Architectural Designer
Phone calls or applications received by mail will not be accepted. All potential candidates must have legal work status in the United States. Selldorf Architects is an equal-opportunity employer.
